architecture.one_liner: AI runs where it earns its place: reading documents, retrieving rules, reasoning over both. Then AI stops. No language model sits on the code path that generates the audited artifact.

stages.why: Multimodal PDF extraction over messy, mixed-modality attachments: pay stubs, insurance cards, prescriptions, denial letters. Vision handles what regex cannot.
Embedding + rerank surface the eligibility rules that apply to this case, from a pgvector store populated at startup from human-authored YAML. The model's job is to find, not to invent.
Structured-JSON verdict over the retrieved rules. Non-reasoning mode is deliberate: the reasoning variant burns output tokens on trace and returns empty content on this task shape.

reuse.principle: Hybrid: hackathon-window pipeline (Verdikt) composed onto a pre-existing doc-gen kernel (Quire). Mechanical boundaries make the split provable.

judging_criteria.note: Three NVIDIA models composed at their strongest task shapes on one Nebius key, with per-call routing instrumentation. Deterministic render boundary enforced in tests. One-way dependency prevents substrate contamination. Every inter-stage artifact is a structured pydantic model, independently testable at each seam.

Observable end-to-end. Every stage's output is a structured artifact a human reviewer can read: intake, retrieved rules with rerank scores, decision with citations, rendered letter. Admin routing-table page surfaces model-selection decisions as live data.

Patient Assistance Programs are one instance of a class: regulated document workflows where the letter that leaves the building is the audit artifact. Prior authorization, benefit verification, informed consent, MedWatch reporting all share the same shape. Onboarding a second program is a data change, not a build.

Most 2026 doc-gen submissions put a language model on the artifact-generation code path. Verdikt refuses. The EU AI Act categorizes healthcare eligibility decisions as high-risk and demands the exact reproducibility guarantees Verdikt provides mechanically. Building audit-defensible in 2026 is ahead of the regulatory curve, not behind the capability curve.
